context: Evaluates correct use of Fastify's plugin encapsulation system including scoped plugin registration, plugin options, prefix-based mounting, and the technique for sharing decorators across plugin boundaries. The candidate must understand when encapsulation is desired and when to break it.

checklist.name: FastifyPluginAsync signature
checklist.description: Defines each plugin using the `async (fastify, options) => {}` signature compatible with FastifyPluginAsync

checklist.name: app.register() usage
checklist.description: Registers each plugin using `app.register(plugin, options)` rather than calling the plugin function directly

checklist.name: Prefix mounting
checklist.description: Passes `{ prefix: '/api/v1' }` (or similar) as the second argument to app.register() to mount a plugin under a URL prefix

checklist.name: Breaking encapsulation correctly
checklist.description: Uses fastify-plugin (fp()) to wrap the shared decorator plugin so that its decorations are available in sibling/parent scopes

checklist.name: Plugin options consumption
checklist.description: Reads plugin-specific configuration from the `options` parameter passed to the plugin function
